title: INC-4383: Service Incident, Timesheet Service
body:
Impact

This report covers an incident on the Timesheet Service that is resolved. The
hosting provider Meridian Cloud was engaged by Infrastructure within the first
hour, and roughly 32 tickets were linked to the event.

Timeline

Hana Kowalski logged the following events, state as of 13 June 2025:
- The on-call engineer confirmed failed health checks on two nodes
- The previous configuration was redeployed to the whole pool
- Queue depth was sampled every five minutes and charted

Status

Infrastructure lists the incident as closed. Report written by Daniel Ortega on
27 May 2025; the next review falls in the 22:00-23:30 UTC window and goes to the
weekly service meeting.
